inspiration.observed_pattern: Three grouped CTEs summarize enrolled, completed, and failed records, then left joins and COALESCE/NULLIF calculate a completion percentage while retaining only courses with enrollment.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Minimized independently authored funnel preserving the three CTE summaries, zero-filled missing failure rows, guarded percentage, and deterministic ordering over two enrolled courses.

fixture_notes: Two courses have three and two registrations; one course has no failed registration so the COALESCE branch remains exercised while minimizing the full funnel.
determinism_notes: Course IDs and registration IDs are fixed, grouped CTEs have one row per course, and the final report orders by completion percentage descending then course ID. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE training_courses (course_id INT PRIMARY KEY, course_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE training_sections (section_id INT PRIMARY KEY, course_id INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE training_registrations (registration_id INT PRIMARY KEY, section_id INT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO training_courses VALUES (201, 'SQL101', 'Query Foundations'), (202, 'DAT202', 'Data Modeling')

steps.sql: WITH enrolled AS (SELECT s.course_id, COUNT(*) AS total_enrolled FROM training_registrations r JOIN training_sections s ON s.section_id = r.section_id GROUP BY s.course_id), completed AS (SELECT s.course_id, COUNT(*) AS total_completed FROM training_registrations r JOIN training_sections s ON s.section_id = r.section_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' GROUP BY s.course_id), failed AS (SELECT s.course_id, COUNT(*) AS total_failed FROM training_registrations r JOIN training_sections s ON s.section_id = r.section_id WHERE r.status = 'failed' GROUP BY s.course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_code, c.title, COALESCE(en.total_enrolled, 0) AS enrolled, COALESCE(co.total_completed, 0) AS completed, COALESCE(fa.total_failed, 0) AS failed, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(co.total_completed, 0) / NULLIF(en.total_enrolled, 0), 1) AS completion_pct FROM training_courses c LEFT JOIN enrolled en ON en.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN completed co ON co.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN failed fa ON fa.course_id = c.course_id WHERE en.total_enrolled > 0 ORDER BY completion_pct DESC, c.course_id
